Note: MUST be fitted. TIA stability needs Cf >= sqrt(Cin/(2*pi*Rf*GBW)); with ~100 pF of cable, Rf = 2M2 and the LMP7721's 17 MHz GBW that is ~0.65 pF, so 10 pF has wide margin (sets a 7.2 kHz / 159 Hz pole).
Any 1 uF >=16 V X5R/X7R 0603 works; confirm JLCPCB stock of C15849 when ordering.
Tied to VREF, not the rails: 0 V bias means near-zero leakage into the pA node (20-50 pA per diode at 2.5 V reverse).
High-value TIA feedback: guard the pads, keep them clean, no flux residue. JLC/LCSC has no HVCB stock: use Uniroyal 1206W4F1006T5E (C59781), 1% +-100 ppm/C.
Protects the LMP7721 IN+ from transients on VREF; carries only fA.
ALERT/RDY is open-drain - this pull-up is required
Isolation resistor: MCP6002 driving >100 pF of cable needs Riso (DS20001733L section 4.3). Isolation resistor so the MCP6002 VREF buffer can drive C9.
Series protection at the BNC: anti-surge (pulse-rated, AEC-Q200) 0603, limits the current into D1. 10 uV drop per nA. HAND-SOLDER from the Digi-Key order (not in the JLC assembly files).
Electrometer TIA. Guard ring (VREF) on both layers around pins 1/8 and the feedback parts, no solder mask there. Clean flux off after soldering.
